runs.expectation_basis: CodeIgniter reconnect() pings, and on failure closes and initializes a new connection. It does not change transDepth or transStatus. The marker inserted before wait_timeout is already gone. A later insert on the new connection autocommits. transComplete or transCommit then returns true because mysqli commit on the new connection succeeds. That true is not a commit of the timed-out transaction.
runs.reason: reconnect opened a new connection, left depth at 1, and the completion call returned true without the timed-out marker
